messages:
support_jen: Heads up — customer (acct 5421) reported batch /v1/rerank where per-query candidate lists appear shifted between queries. No 4xx, request returns OK but scores map to wrong queries.

customer_alex: repro payload attached. We send 3 queries with 5 candidates each but response looks like first query got candidates 2..6 (one-off). Happens intermittently on large batches (> 200 queries).

support_jen: @jules_ml any quick theories? Could be serialization or the per-query boundary parsing in the batching layer. :thinking_face:

jules_ml: Can you paste the request body (sanitized) and the response snippet? Also which client/SDK?

customer_alex: sure — using our node client v0.23.1. Payload (sanitized):

```json
{
  "model": "re-ranker-large",
  "queries": ["q1","q2","q3"],
  "per_query_candidates": [
    [{"id":"c1"},{"id":"c2"},{"id":"c3"},{"id":"c4"},{"id":"c5"}],
    [{"id":"d1"},{"id":"d2"},{"id":"d3"},{"id":"d4"},{"id":"d5"}],
    [{"id":"e1"},{"id":"e2"},{"id":"e3"},{"id":"e4"},{"id":"e5"}]
  ]
}
```

customer_alex: response scores look like they were attributed as if per_query_candidates flattened and then chunked incorrectly. I can attach a small failing payload if you want to repro locally.

sam_engineer: thanks. Quick question: are you sending the body as JSON or as form-encoded (Content-Type)? Also any newline normalization / ndjson pipeline?

customer_alex: JSON, Content-Type: application/json. We also gzip payloads for big batches.

anna_sre: @sam_engineer could gzip + our streaming parser be dropping a bracket occasionally? low-level parser bug would explain intermittent and scale-dependent failures.

jules_ml: can you attach the exact raw bytes (base64 ok) for a failing case? I want to check if there are trailing commas or accidental concatenation between requests in the same connection.

customer_alex: pasted one failing raw body here (base64). Also note we stream 8 requests per HTTP/2 connection.

support_jen: I ran a quick check against a dev instance with same payload and reproduced once. Stack trace showed no exception; server returned 200 with `results` array length equal to total candidates instead of per-query buckets.

jules_ml: That matches a bug class where the batching component flattens all candidate arrays into a single buffer, then re-slices using an older index array when concurrent requests reorder completion. Possible race between request->encode and request->route.

sam_engineer: Can you run this curl test for me to verify behavior with gzip disabled and single connection?

```bash
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ..." \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data-binary @small_repro.json
```

customer_alex: ran curl raw (no gzip) with single query and works. With 3 queries still fails sometimes. With gzip off and single connection but many queries in one request it fails more rarely.

jules_ml: ok hypothesis: bug triggered by parallelism + gzip + HTTP/2 request multiplexing. I'll instrument the batching pipeline to log candidate offsets and add a guard to validate per_query_candidates lengths against returned buckets.

support_jen: escalation notes for SOC: impacted customer on paid plan, some production calls mis-reranking UX, low frequency but can affect ranking-critical pages. Billing unaffected but user experience is degraded.

anna_sre: I'll pull traces from the time window and correlate with canary deploys or kernel upgrades on the nodes — maybe a library change in our JSON parser.

deploy-bot: canary rollout started for rerank batching fix to staging at sha: ab12cde. (automated)

jules_ml: quick mitigation: validate on ingest that sum(len(arr) for arr in per_query_candidates) == total_candidates_metadata (we'll add a hard error). Also added a checksum header that clients can echo to detect reordering.

customer_alex: thanks — can we get ETA for a patch? This is high priority for us.

jules_ml: patch built and running in staging. ETA for prod rollout 2 hours after monitoring green. I'll DM you when prod rolled.

support_jen: thx all. Leaving this thread open until prod verifies. :pray:

customer_alex: appreciated — I'll watch and report if I still see misalignment after rollout.

jules_ml: PROD rollout done, added extra validation and a hotfix to the batching serializer. If you still see mismatches please include raw_request_id header and sample raw body.

customer_alex: verified on a couple of previously failing payloads — looks good now. No more shifted candidates. Thanks! :tada:

support_jen: closing after customer confirmation. Logged follow-up ticket to add end-to-end fuzzer for per-query boundaries.
